div.l: For he hadde getȳn hȳm ȝit no bn̄benefys
Ne was so wordely for to hauyn offys
For hym was lefere to haue at hese bedis hed
Twenty bokꝭis I clad in blak or red
Of Aristotle ⁊and his philoso phie
Þan robis ryche or fedele or gay sautrie
But al be þᵗat he was a philisofre
Þᵗat hadde but lityl gold in cofre
But al þᵗat he myȝte of hese frendis hente
On bokis ⁊and on lernȳnge he it spente
And besily gan for þe soulys preye
Of hēm þᵗat ȝaf hȳm wherwith to schole heye
Of stodie tok he most kep ⁊and most hede
Not a word spak he more þān was nede
And þᵗat was seyd in forme ⁊and reuerence
And schort ⁊and quik ⁊and ful of hey sentence
Sounynge in moral uertu was hese speche
And gladly wolde he lerne ⁊and gladli te che Seregeaūn
A seriaunt of the lawe bothe war ⁊and wys
That oftyn hadde ben at þᵉ paruys
He was also ryche of excellence
Discret he was ⁊and of gret reuerence
He semede swich hese wordis were so wyse
Iustyse he was ful oftyn in asyse
Be patent ⁊and be pleyn cōmmyssioūn
For hese sience ⁊and for hese heye renoūn
Of feis ⁊and robis hadde he manyon
So gret a purchasour was neủere non
Al was fesymple to hȳm in effect
His purchase myȝte not ben enfect
Neủere so besy aman as he þere nas
And þᵗat he semede besiere þan he was
In termys hadde he cas ⁊and domys alle
Þᵗat frōm the tyme of kyng welyam were falle
